resources.string: Experimental launcher animation duration control for LSPosed. HyperOS 4 compatibility unverified.
Your animations. Your flow. Your HyperOS.

Experimental: change the duration of standard ValueAnimator animations inside the Xiaomi launcher. This may affect more launcher effects than app opening and closing. Spring animations and system-managed transitions are not controlled. HyperOS 4 compatibility is unverified.

1. Install and enable HyperDream in LSPosed.

2. Select only the Xiaomi launcher (com.miui.home) in its scope.

3. Reboot your test device.

4. Check LSPosed logs for the HyperDream diagnostic message.
Activation is not detected by this screen. Use LSPosed logs to verify loading. Controls are off by default. A saved setting does not prove an animation was affected.
Test on a device you can recover. Disable HyperDream in LSPosed and reboot if problems occur.
Settings save automatically. Reboot after any change, including disabling or restoring defaults. Running launcher animations keep the previous configuration until its process restarts.
